## kb_to_source

All normative sentences sourced (including "When private-pay billing resumes, the agreement records the first day billed privately again as its conversion date" ← events/db_schema conversion_date meaning). No added step, confirmation, cross-problem guidance or world state.
Notes:
- K1: resumption_deposit_recurring_services_99ce817c hypothetical "An oxygen concentrator first charged last month next to a longer-running cable service, the latest service month's recurring charges totalling 150.00: 150.00" mirrors this task's world (an oxygen concentrator newly charged beside a longer-running recurring service → the rule-2 tier this task takes) and is not producible under the published ancillary rules: cable 42.00 + a first oxygen month of 108.00 needs 185.00 × d / D = 108.00, which has no whole-day solution for D = 28–31 (nearest 107.42, 108.45). 150.00 also equals task 0's scored insurer daily benefit.
- S2 (policy-side): recurring rule 2 "the recurring charges of the latest service month billed (the one posted first where two share a posting date)" is in the source rule of both deposit policies; the parenthetical reads as a single-entry tie-break. Here the two 2026-09 charges (telephone 29.00, oxygen 185.00) share posting date 2026-10-04, so a literal reading gives 29.00 and a deposit of 827.67 instead of 214.00 / 1012.67. The KB carries the sentence verbatim; the plural and the worked cases (68.00, 150.00 totals) point to the sum the GT uses.
